Questions

Got a question?

Is Streetak free?

Yes. Streetak is a free football game on Android, iPhone and the web. The shop sells looks only (kits, balls, card frames), and nothing you can buy makes anyone stronger.

Which phones does it run on?

Android phones from Google Play and iPhones from the App Store. If you would rather not download anything, play in the browser at play.streetak.com on a phone or a computer.

Can I play with my friends?

Of course. Make a room, send the code to your friends and play online, 3v3 or 5v5 with a keeper. If someone is missing, bots fill in. You can also start a club with your name and enter cups, including a Ramadan cup.

Is it in Arabic?

Yes. The whole game is in Egyptian Arabic, with an Egyptian commentator who lives the match with you, and it is in English too.

How do you play?

You control one player, and the ball is free, not glued to your feet. You have the street skills: nutmegs, rainbows, roulettes, step-overs, the fake shot and slide tackles. Matches last four minutes, on courts like a Cairo rooftop, an alley, by the pyramids, Neon Cairo and space.
